size.raw: Rs 550 crore first close; target Rs 1,700 crore

strategy.thesis: India's leading healthcare-dedicated venture capital fund, co-founded by Quadria Capital in 2016, backing healthtech, medtech, novel healthcare-delivery and biopharma-technology companies that tackle Asia's access, affordability and quality challenges.

summary.en: HealthQuad is India's leading healthcare-focused venture capital fund, co-founded by Quadria Capital in 2016, investing in healthtech, medtech, biopharma-technology and new healthcare-delivery models across India's health system.

sources.title: About HealthQuad
sources.quote: HealthQuad has backed more than 18 firms through its first two funds. Its portfolio includes Qure.ai, Wysa, Redcliffe Labs, GoApptiv, CureSkin, Strand Life Sciences, THB, ekincare and Medikabazaar.

sources.title: India's largest healthcare VC HealthQuad closes second fund, raising $162 million
sources.quote: HealthQuad Fund-II raised $162 million, more than double its initial target.

sources.title: HealthQuad raises Rs 550 crore in first close of Fund III to back Indian healthcare startups
sources.supports: Fund III first close and target size, sector focus
sources.quote: HealthQuad's third fund has secured Rs 550 crore in commitments for its first close, and is targeting Rs 1,700 crore to invest in early-growth companies across healthtech, medtech, biopharma technology and new healthcare delivery models.

strategy.thesis: Early-stage, healthcare-only fund following a 'found and fund' company-creation and incubation model, building and backing healthtech startups across the India-US corridor spanning chronic disease, maternal/pediatric care and mental health.

summary.en: W Health Ventures is an early-stage healthcare-only fund investing in and building healthtech companies across India and the United States through a company-creation ('found and fund') model.

sources.title: W Health to Double Down on India-US Health Startups with $100Mn Fund II
sources.supports: founding year, Fund II size, company-creation model
sources.quote: Founded in 2019, W Health Ventures invests in healthcare businesses across India and the United States. The firm follows a company-creation and incubation model, working closely with founders to build and scale ventures from inception.

sources.title: W Health Ventures Raises INR 550 Cr in Initial Close of Fund II
sources.supports: Fund II first close size and target
sources.quote: W Health Ventures has announced the first close of its second fund at INR 550 crore, moving closer to its target corpus of around INR 630 crore.

sources.title: W Health Ventures - Investor Profile, Portfolio
sources.quote: The organization has a portfolio of 13 companies, showcasing its commitment to enhancing healthcare through technology.

funds.name: Somerset Indus Healthcare India Fund (Fund II)

strategy.thesis: Healthcare-dedicated growth-equity firm making controlling or influential minority investments in small and mid-sized Indian healthcare services and products companies; Fund III targets hospitals, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, medical devices and digital health, with an emphasis on Tier II/III cities.

summary.en: Somerset Indus Capital Partners is a Mumbai-based, healthcare-only growth-equity firm investing in Indian hospitals, diagnostics, pharma, medtech and digital-health companies, with a Fund III focus on Tier II/III cities.

sources.title: About Us
sources.supports: HQ, founding, investment approach, sector focus
sources.quote: Somerset Indus Capital Partners makes controlling or influential minority investments in small and mid-sized Indian companies in the healthcare services and products sector. The firm is based in Worli, Mumbai, India and specializes in the healthcare sector.

sources.title: Healthcare investment in India: Somerset Indus Fund III
sources.supports: Fund III size, sector focus, portfolio track record
sources.quote: Somerset Indus Capital Partners recently announced the final close of its third fund at approximately $288 million, exceeding its initial fundraising target of $250 million due to strong investor demand. Fund III invests in growth-stage healthcare businesses targeting companies across hospitals, diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and digital health, emphasizing Tier II and Tier III cities.

strategy.thesis: India's leading life-sciences private equity firm, investment advisor to the India Life Sciences Fund (ILSF) family, providing growth capital to pharma, healthcare-delivery, medtech, animal-health, nutraceutical and healthtech companies.

summary.en: InvAscent is India's leading life-sciences private equity firm, advising the India Life Sciences Fund family, deploying growth capital across pharma, healthcare delivery, medtech, animal health and healthtech.

sources.title: InvAscent: Home
sources.supports: founding year, AUM, sectors, portfolio count
sources.quote: InvAscent was founded in 2005 and is the investment advisor to a family of funds that operate under the name "India Life Sciences Fund" or ILSF. InvAscent is India's leading life sciences private equity firm managing an AUM of over USD 800 million with investments in over 35 companies across pharma, healthcare delivery, medical devices, animal health, nutraceuticals, and healthtech industries.

strategy.thesis: India-focused growth-stage healthcare investment platform launched in 2025 by former HealthQuad/KOIS team members, deploying a sector-specific fund across healthtech (~50% of capital), biopharma, medtech, healthcare delivery and climate health.

summary.en: HealthKois is a new ($300-400M) India-focused growth-stage healthcare investment fund launched in 2025 by Charles Janssen, Ajay Mahipal and Dr. Pinak Shrikhande after their split from HealthQuad/Quadria, targeting healthtech, biopharma, medtech and healthcare-delivery companies.

sources.title: HealthKois Unveils $400 Million Investment Fund to Power India's Next Wave of HealthTech and Biopharma Innovation
sources.supports: fund size, sector allocation, check size
sources.quote: HealthKois, a newly established growth-stage healthcare investment platform, has announced the launch of a $400 million sector-specific fund to support early growth-stage companies in healthtech, biopharma, medtech, healthcare delivery, and related sectors. The fund targets an initial corpus of $300 million, with an additional green shoe option of $100 million.

sources.title: Quadria Group Launches $300 Mn HealthQuad Fund After Split With KOIS
sources.quote: HealthKois has been launched by KOIS, led by Charles Janssen, along with Ajay Mahipal and Dr. Pinak Shrikhande—all Key Managerial Personnel at HealthQuad, India's leading healthcare transformation fund.

verification_notes: Newly launched (mid-2025) following a split between Quadria Capital and KOIS, who previously co-managed HealthQuad together; no portfolio track record yet at time of research.

strategy.thesis: Dedicated healthcare & life-sciences private equity fund managed by Tata Capital, backing high-growth, market-leading private healthcare businesses across digital health, single-specialty hospitals, pharmaceuticals and healthcare-technology solutions.

summary.en: Tata Capital Healthcare Fund is a dedicated healthcare and life-sciences private equity fund managed by Tata Capital, with three vintages since 2012 and roughly US$200M raised, backing hospitals, diagnostics, pharma and digital-health companies in India.

sources.title: Tata Capital Healthcare Fund
sources.supports: fund size/vintages, sector focus, portfolio count, notable investments, awards
sources.quote: The fund has raised US$ 200M across multiple vehicles, consisting of three funds with vintages in 2012, 2022, and 2026... targets India's Healthcare & Lifesciences industry, with a particular emphasis on private healthcare businesses. Key thematic areas include digital health, single-specialty hospitals, pharmaceuticals, and healthcare technology solutions... 19 Investments and 8 Exits.

verification_notes: Managed by Tata Capital's institutional private-equity arm as a financial investment vehicle (not a strategic corporate/CVC arm of a healthcare operating business), so classified as growth-equity VC rather than CVC.

strategy.thesis: Impact-focused early-stage venture fund backing startups serving India's underserved 'base of the pyramid' populations; healthcare is one of three core, long-running dedicated verticals (alongside education and fintech), not incidental sector exposure.

summary.en: Unitus Ventures (formerly Unitus Seed Fund) is a Capria Network-affiliated impact venture fund investing in early-stage Indian startups, with healthcare as one of three dedicated core sectors alongside education and fintech.

sources.title: We're doubling-down on healthcare investments
sources.quote: Unitus invests in startups across Healthcare, Education and Financial Technology, which have a passion for serving the masses with disruptive, scalable solutions and aim to create sustainable employment opportunities for India's low-income population.

sources.title: Unitus Seed Fund
sources.quote: Its first fund was US$23 million and in 2016 it started raising a second fund with a target of US$50 million.

sources.title: Unitus Seed Fund's Investments Impact 1.2 Million Lives Across India
sources.quote: As of 30 June 2017, Unitus Ventures's active portfolio of 14 companies have directly impacted over 1.2 million BoP (Base of the Economic Pyramid) lives across 29 states in India and created over 6,200 sustainable, quality jobs.

verification_notes: Healthcare is one of three core investment verticals, not the fund's sole focus; portfolio_count figure is across all sectors (health/education/fintech combined), not health-specific. [QA-fix 2026-07-14] Fund II size corrected $50M->$45.2M target (firm's 2018 announcement via Inc42; $50M was the 2016 launch figure).

strategy.thesis: Early-stage deep-tech VC investing at the intersection of science and technology; healthtech is one of its core, long-running dedicated sectors alongside agritech, backing deep-tech-enabled diagnostics and healthcare-access startups.

summary.en: Ankur Capital is a Mumbai-based early-stage deep-tech VC whose core sectors include healthtech alongside agritech, edtech and fintech, notably backing AI-driven diagnostics startup Niramai.
